package.name: i2rt_hardware_interface
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface plugin for the I2RT YAM arm. Thin glue between i2rt_can_driver (the ported DM motor protocol) and hardware_interface::SystemInterface: exports per-joint position/velocity/ effort command and state interfaces, and publishes per-motor diagnostics (temperature, error code) as i2rt_msgs/MotorStatus.
